agreements: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; this review changes no formal state and claims no C PASS.
Heartbeat, poll, retry, reconnect, wait, scheduler wake, window age and uptime are zero Experience.
DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND are operational progress only under v2.1 and must not become verified Experience, P_base, Trust, Identity, Personality or Governance evidence.
v2.1 strict-bool checks for secretary_signal_fresh, authority_conflict and direct event_independently_verified are valid local hardening but do not prove provenance or authority.
verified_progress_density is currently reason-only and must remain observational/non-authoritative unless independently derived and adversarially validated.
GEARBOX_V2_1_CONTRACT correctly marks speed improvement NOT_YET_STATISTICALLY_ESTABLISHED.
v2.1 formal_mutation_allowed remains false and P_base remains read-only.

disagreements.finding: New this run: select_gear_v2_1 inherits v2.selected_gear but GearboxV21Decision drops v2 checkpoint_required, receiver_ack_required, verification_gate, real_experience_claim_allowed and pressure_score/base safety context. A downstream consumer using only v2.1 output can therefore lose mandatory checkpoint/ACK/verification semantics even when the inherited v2 decision required them.
disagreements.required_change: v2.1 must preserve or explicitly re-project all authoritative safety metadata from the exact inherited v2 decision, bound to an inherited decision fingerprint. A v2.1 wrapper must never weaken checkpoint, ACK or verification-gate requirements; any mismatch fails closed.

disagreements.finding: The stale-secretary gate neutralizes only secretary_level. context_load_ratio, tool_failure_ratio, stale_pointer_ratio, continuity_anchor_health and other pressure inputs can still carry stale secretary-derived information and force checkpoint/downshift when secretary_signal_fresh=false.
disagreements.required_change: Bind provenance/freshness per pressure signal or consume a typed pressure telemetry envelope; stale/authority-conflicting secretary-derived components must be ignored while independently sourced trusted runtime telemetry remains eligible.

disagreements.finding: secretary_signal_fresh and authority_conflict are strict bools but remain caller declarations without replay-resistant source, timestamp/TTL, policy and installation/runtime binding.
disagreements.required_change: Use typed SecretarySignalEnvelope and AuthorityDecisionEnvelope bound to exact source, scope, freshness, policy and installation/runtime identity.

disagreements.finding: authority_conflict only disables secretary_level; it does not load/project/enforce the actual fresh authority decision. Therefore 'fresh authority always wins' is stronger than the current executable guarantee.
disagreements.required_change: Consume exact trusted authority state/gear constraints; missing, stale, revoked, cross-mission or cross-install authority evidence must fail closed.

disagreements.finding: recent_shift_rate_ratio is caller supplied and thresholded at >=0.50 without canonical numerator/denominator, minimum support, observation window, uncertainty or independent enter/exit hysteresis.
disagreements.required_change: Derive shift rate from canonical append-only shift history with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and stateful hysteretic release behavior.

disagreements.finding: Anti-thrash can reduce gear_shift_rate while delaying necessary safe upshift and worsening cycle_completion_latency, verified_closure throughput or recovery_latency.
disagreements.required_change: Require matched performance non-regression and bounded release/cooldown; fewer shifts alone is not improvement.

disagreements.finding: Verified Experience still requires only event kind plus a boolean; no exact evidence hash, verifier identity or trusted C/independent-verifier receipt is required.
disagreements.required_change: Require immutable evidence identity and trusted verifier receipt bound to mission/step/scope, freshness/revocation and installation/workspace identity.

disagreements.finding: event_id dedupe exists only inside one aggregate invocation; the same evidence under new IDs, cross-run replay, rollback/poll replay and same-ID rebinding can still be re-credited.
disagreements.required_change: Use a durable rollback-resistant event/evidence-lineage acceptance registry with exact replay=no-op, same-evidence/new-ID=lineage duplicate and same-ID/different-binding=IDENTITY_CONFLICT.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 recomputes verified and operational deltas directly from caller event fields, bypassing aggregate_experience_events and any future durable-ledger repair.
disagreements.required_change: Both credit classes must come from one immutable AcceptedExperienceReceipt; receipt-less decision calls emit zero credit.

disagreements.finding: Gearbox v2 publicly mixes DURABLE_PROGRESS and ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND into experience_candidate_delta, allowing legacy consumers to misclassify operational progress as Experience-labelled credit.
disagreements.required_change: Make verified Experience and operational progress distinct authoritative fields at the shared intake; legacy mixed credit must be research-only/non-authoritative.

disagreements.finding: select_gear_v2_1 executes int(selected[1:]) although inherited v1/v2 can legally return N or R, so standby/rollback paths can raise ValueError.
disagreements.required_change: Handle N/R before G-gear parsing; N returns standby and R returns rollback immediately with zero credit and no anti-thrash interference.

disagreements.finding: current_gear is caller supplied while controlling v2 hysteresis and v2.1 anti-thrash.
disagreements.required_change: Derive current_gear from canonical monotonic runtime/shift state bound to runtime/install identity and policy hash.

disagreements.finding: verification_stage is caller supplied; self-reporting C_VERIFIED can remove the unverified G4 cap without exact C evidence.
disagreements.required_change: Derive verification_stage only from trusted verifier/acceptance receipts bound to exact mission, step, scope, evidence, freshness and revocation state.

disagreements.finding: 5/4/3 verified credits and operational 1 are engineering heuristics, not calibrated capability units.
disagreements.required_change: Never interpret aggregate credit as capability truth, Trust, Identity/Personality evidence or promotion threshold.

disagreements.finding: No executable matched paired-baseline protocol currently establishes speedup; commit count, wake count or awake time are invalid substitutes.
disagreements.required_change: Use sealed matched workloads and paired/crossover baselines over durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with uncertainty, full assigned-workload coverage and verification/risk non-regression.

statistical_risks: Dropping inherited v2 safety metadata creates survivorship in downstream telemetry: successful gear values may be observed while required checkpoint/ACK/verification obligations silently disappear.
Stale secretary-derived pressure telemetry can remain causally active unless freshness/provenance is bound per field/source.
Caller-forged freshness, authority conflict, current gear or verification stage invalidates causal routing comparisons.
Small-n shift-rate estimates have extreme variance; a single >=0.50 threshold can false-trigger or chatter without independent release hysteresis.
Anti-thrash can reduce apparent gear_shift_rate while worsening cycle latency, verified closure throughput or recovery latency.
verified_progress_density becomes self-reinforcing if later wired from policy-created progress back into upshift decisions.
Transient event identity plus direct decision-path credit can inflate longitudinal verified/operational totals.
Legacy mixed experience_candidate_delta can contaminate downstream Experience-labelled longitudinal metrics with operational progress.
5/4/3/1 credits are ordinal engineering heuristics, not capability units.
durable_progress_per_wake is denominator-sensitive; verified_closure_per_hour is exposure/censoring-sensitive; fixed treatment order and completed-only analysis add carryover and survivorship bias.
proposed_tests: GB21-INHERITED-SAFETY-METADATA-063: create v2 decisions requiring checkpoint/receiver ACK and non-promotion verification gate; v2.1 output must preserve those obligations exactly or fail closed.

GB21-INHERITED-DECISION-FINGERPRINT-064: mutate inherited checkpoint_required/verification_gate/receiver_ack metadata after v2 decision construction; v2.1 must detect fingerprint mismatch and refuse projection.
GB21-STALE-PRESSURE-PROVENANCE-059 + STALE-PRESSURE-MIXED-SOURCE-060: stale secretary-derived telemetry has zero routing effect while fresh independently sourced runtime telemetry remains eligible.
GB21-AUTHORITY-DECISION-PROJECTION-028: trusted authority=G1/recovery must project G1 even when fallback caller kwargs are permissive.
GB21-SHIFT-RATE-PROVENANCE-017 + SHIFT-SMALL-N-004 + ANTI-THRASH-CHATTER-040 + RELEASE-041: canonical shift ledger, adequate support, uncertainty and bounded enter/exit behavior are required.
GB21-PROGRESS-DENSITY-FORGE-007: verified_progress_density=1 alone has zero routing/Experience/promotion/authority effect.
GB21-CROSS-RUN-SAME-ID-018 + ROLLBACK-LEDGER-019 + POLL-REPLAY-020 + EVENT-REBIND-021: durable exactly-once and identity-conflict semantics survive restart, rollback and polling.
GB21-VERIFIER-EVIDENCE-011: verified kind without exact evidence hash plus trusted verifier/C receipt gets zero credit.
GB21-DIRECT-CREDIT-BYPASS-022 + OPERATIONAL-CREDIT-BYPASS-024: every nonzero credit is tied to one immutable accepted receipt.
GB21-NR-STATE-043 + ROLLBACK-STATE-044: N/R safety states never enter numeric gear parsing and are never blocked by anti-thrash.
GB21-LEGACY-OPERATIONAL-SEMANTICS-054 + LEGACY-CONSUMER-MISCLASSIFICATION-055: operational events cannot enter authoritative Experience-labelled counters through legacy v2 APIs.
GB21-CREDIT-SCORE-014: equal aggregate scores from different event mixes cannot imply equivalent capability or trigger promotion.

GB21-PAIRED-SPEED-015 + WAKE-DENOMINATOR-FREEZE-030 + TIME-WINDOW-FREEZE-032 + ORDER-CROSSOVER-036 + ITT-WORKLOAD-COVERAGE-038: speedup requires matched workload, frozen denominator/exposure policy, crossover/order control, full assigned-workload coverage and uncertainty/non-regression.

release_condition.formal: Existing A->B->C only; this review cannot promote v2.1 or alter formal authority.
release_condition.safety_projection: v2.1 must preserve the complete inherited v2 safety decision, including checkpoint, receiver ACK and verification-gate semantics, with an exact inherited-decision binding.
release_condition.secretary: Secretary/pressure inputs must be provenance- and freshness-bound; stale secretary data cannot affect routing.
release_condition.authority: Fresh authority must be consumed as an exact trusted decision/snapshot, not represented only by caller booleans.
release_condition.anti_thrash: Shift rate must be canonically derived with preregistered support/window/uncertainty and hysteretic release; safety downshift immediate and safe-upshift performance non-inferior.
release_condition.experience: Only durable replay-resistant accepted receipts bound to exact evidence and trusted verifier identity may create verified Experience; DURABLE_PROGRESS/ADVERSARIAL_DEFECT_FOUND remain operational-only; runtime maintenance remains zero Experience.
release_condition.credit_semantics: 5/4/3/1 are heuristic engineering weights only and cannot be interpreted as calibrated capability or personality truth.
release_condition.speed: No speedup claim until sealed matched-workload paired/crossover baseline reports durable_progress_per_wake, verified_closure_per_hour, cycle_completion_latency, rework_ratio and recovery_latency with frozen denominator/exposure/censoring/order/coverage policy, uncertainty and verification/risk non-regression.
release_condition.baseline: Gearbox v1 verified baseline and Step009 Heartbeat verified foundation remain preserved; P_base read-only; real_5min_runtime_live remains false absent real always-on evidence.
